messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to enable the `microbatch_prefetch` feature flag for a small canary tonight. want to align on scope and rollback plan.
kevin: +1. what's the canary audience? 1% or pinned keys?
maria: Thinking 1% global traffic on hosted model endpoints + internal test team. not pinned keys.
anjan: We should add a KV-warmup step for the first requests — otherwise you'll see cold misses bump p95.
lia: Agree. We'll run a warmup job that hits top 500 prefixes before enabling. should complete in ~10m.
kevin: What are our alert thresholds? p95 latency increase, error rate, token throughput?
sre-aly: Proposal: trigger if p95 increases > 20% for 5m OR error rate > 0.5% OR token/s drops >15% on the canary shard. alert to #eng-oncall and page if sustained 10m.
maria: Sounds good. I'll add those to the rollout doc. Also include the perf smoke script:
```bash
# perf smoke
curl -s -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"input": "warmup request"}' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate?model=fast-open
```
kevin: pinging reviewers — PR: https://repo/infra/PR/3244 sets the flag gating + warmup job. @anjan @lia can you review?
anjan: On it. quick nit: use `--concurrency 4` for the warmup runner, avoids overloading a single pod.
lia: LGTM after that tweak. I'll merge and schedule the canary at 02:30 PST.
deploy-bot: deploy: feature-flag microbatch_prefetch toggled -> canary (1%) by maria at 1799998950 :rocket:
maria: Canary live. monitoring dashboards: "microbatch/canary/p95", "kv/hit_rate", "serving/error_rate".
sre-aly: early signal: kv hit rate rose from 3%->18% (expected). p95 rose 6% so far, token/s stable. no errors.
kevin: Good sign. keep an eye on tail latencies for long contexts.
anjan: If p95 crosses threshold we have immediate rollback: `ffctl unset microbatch_prefetch --env=prod` (ops runbook step 4).
lia: Also prepped canary rollback playbook in runbook doc with dashboard links and run commands.
maria: Plan: hold at 1% for 30m, then 10% for 20m, then full. abort if any trigger.
kevin: Will run a small A/B eval using our perf harness against the canary after 15m to validate generation quality + perf.
sre-aly: Noted. paging policy in place. ping me if you want me to page on any threshold hit.
maria: thanks all. will post final status after the 10% step. :white_check_mark:
